meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出有辨识度、不落俗套的界面设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想做出有辨识度、不显模板化的界面。
copy.tagline_en: Create distinctive, intentional UI with confident visual choices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a distinctive look beyond default templates.

howto.what: Claude 会以设计负责人的方式工作:先产出配色、字体、布局和签名元素的设计计划,自查是否像通用模板并修改,再按计划写页面代码、撰写界面文案,并保证响应式、键盘焦点与减少动效。
howto.when: 在构建新界面或改造已有界面、需要确定视觉方向时触发;原文未给出触发词,由技能自行判断并先定下产品的具体主题。

say.text: 帮我设计一个咖啡器具品牌的落地页。
say.note: 会先出设计计划再写代码。

say.text: 把现在的首页改得不像模板,换配色和字体。
say.note: 会针对这个 brief 重做配色与字体。

say.text: 先只给我设计计划:配色、字体、布局、签名元素。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as design lead: it drafts a plan (palette, type, layout, one signature element), checks it isn't a templated default and revises it, then writes the page code to that plan, plus the UI copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when building a new UI or reshaping an existing one and a visual direction is needed; no trigger words are given, so it pins the subject itself.

say_en.text: Design a landing page for a coffee-gear brand.
Rework the homepage so it doesn't look templated.
say_en.note: Redoes palette and type for the brief.

say_en.text: Just give me the design plan: color, type, layout, signature.
